svg.title: B24 VIPER VOYAGER — Urban Movement and Habitat Connectivity engineering architecture
svg.desc: The architecture separates dated cover exposure, conditional movement choice and utilization-area endpoints. Restricted refuges and sparse-cadence limits remain visible, and observed associations do not establish demographic or mitigation effects.
